part_a.label: HA1 Record a delivered report
part_a.action: Record the delivery date and Google Doc link of a 40-page reading that has already passed acceptance, publication and QA, in the run log and on the client's Notion page; nothing later depends on this step.

part_a.label: HA2 Two named one-line fixes
part_a.action: Correct one misspelled gate name and one wrong table caption in an accepted 40-page reading, each named by section and line; the deterministic mechanical and structure checks re-run before the report is republished.

part_a.label: HA3 Repair four named defects
part_a.action: Repair a 40-page reading written on the accepted template against four defects named at acceptance, each with its section, the failed requirement and the evidence; acceptance re-runs every check before the report can be published, and a QA pass follows.

part_a.label: HA4 First parent-child composite
part_a.action: Write the first parent-child composite reading produced on this platform, for paying clients, from a complete packet: both charts, the relationship ledger, a long prompt, a new template version and reference works read passage by passage; later parent-child reports will copy its structure, and the acceptance checks test mechanics and structure, not the interpretation.

part_a.label: HA5 Claim audit of the first six reports
part_a.action: Before the first production reports produced on this platform reach clients, check every claim in six 40-page readings against their chart data and the cited reference passages, section by section; any single reader would miss claims spread across 240 pages.

part_a.label: HA6 Standard single-person reading
part_a.action: Write a standard 40-page single-person reading for a new client from a complete packet on the accepted template, a report type already produced here many times; acceptance checks and a QA pass follow.

part_a.label: HA7 Entry-by-entry glossary check
part_a.action: Before the new 64-gate glossary replaces the old one, check each gate entry against the three reference works it cites, entry by entry.
part_a.note: added at pre-registration review so that the ultracode-on test does not rest on one case

jobs.label: J0 General: a typical three-report request
jobs.action: Run the full Human Design reading production process on this platform for a typical request of three reports for paying clients, two single-person readings and one romantic composite, all report types already produced here: intake, live chart and geocoding calls, three authors in parallel, acceptance checks, native Google Doc publication, same-author QA and filing.

jobs.label: J1 Controller: routine production run
jobs.action: Run the controller session for a routine production request of three reports on accepted templates: intake, live chart and geocoding calls with real keys, dispatching three authors, deterministic acceptance checks, publishing native Google Docs with chart images, dispatching QA and filing records, over about 90 minutes.

jobs.label: J2 Controller: first live production run here
jobs.action: Run the controller session for the first live production request on this platform for paying clients: new adapters, the first live chart and geocoding calls with real keys from here, three authors, acceptance checks, the first native Google Doc publication with chart images, QA and filing.

jobs.label: J3 Author: romantic composite, type already produced
jobs.action: Write a 50-page romantic composite reading for two paying clients from a complete packet (both charts, the relationship ledger, the prompt, the accepted template and reference works read passage by passage), a report type already produced here; acceptance checks and a same-author QA pass follow.

jobs.label: J4 Author: first single-person reading on this platform
jobs.action: Write the first single-person reading produced on this platform, for a paying client, from a complete packet on the accepted template carried over from the previous platform; acceptance checks test mechanics and structure, and a same-author QA pass follows.

jobs.label: J5 Author: focused answer to two questions
jobs.action: Write a 5-page focused answer to a returning client's two specific questions from their accepted chart and earlier full reading, on the accepted component template; acceptance checks and a QA pass follow.

jobs.label: J6 QA: formatting check by the same author
jobs.action: Check a published 40-page reading's Google Doc against its accepted Markdown source with the written formatting checklist, as the same author in the same session; a deterministic Markdown-to-Doc comparison also runs and gates release.

gates.A: hd-v2 is accepted when all seven cases meet every stated expectation (level in the set; ultracode where stated; model where stated). HA1 to HA4 and HA6 carry hd-v1's accepted level sets and models; HA5's level set keeps hd-v1's stakes judgement (it sat above max there). If any fails, one revision (hd-v2.1) is allowed, run on the same cases and marked as fitted to them; if it also fails, Nathan decides.
gates.J: The seven job texts J0 to J6 are re-read and reported, not gated.
